notes: The newest file by name in this folder is the table in force. Refresh with node scripts/pricing-new.mjs, then fill the figures from each family's source page and set fetched to the day you read it.
class maps a model to the skill's capability tier (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) across providers. null means the operator has not placed it yet; the skill treats a null class like a null price.

cache_write for the Anthropic rows is derived as 1.25 times input, the rule the fork_graft operator protocol section 6 uses; the other figures were read from the live pricing page on the fetched date.
A long_context block gives the prices that apply to a whole request once its prompt exceeds threshold_tokens.
OpenAI Sol prices checked 2026-11-04; other families retain their individual fetched dates and were not reassessed.
OpenAI capability classes confirmed by operator 2026-11-04. When multiple models share a class the calculator selects the first listed.

Staleness counts from each family's fetched date: a family's figures are stale when today is more than max_age_days (14) days after it. table_date only names the file (it must equal the filename and not be after today). OpenAI's 2026-11-04 figures therefore go stale on 2026-11-19.

2026-11-10: this file holds both claude-fable-5-2 and claude-fable-5-1, because the live pricing page lists both. The class fable resolves to the first row listed, claude-fable-5-2; claude-fable-5-1 is listed after it so a session on Fable 5.1 is priced here. cache_write_1h is the page's 1-hour cache-write figure (2 times input); a row with none offers none (the OpenAI rows write for 30 minutes).

anthropic.fetched_by: live read 2026-11-10 by two sub-agent reads of the page's Model pricing table, then a second read the same day for the 1-hour cache-write figures (the page states no update date); Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 unchanged from 2026-10-29 apart from cache_write_1h; Fable 5.2 and Fable 5.1 listed; cache_write is the page's 5-minute figure (1.25 times input), cache_write_1h its 1-hour figure (2 times input)
